title: Constant dehomogenization determines a pure power binary form
statement: Let n∈ℕ, let A∈HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n, and let α∈ℂ. If substituting X₀=1 and X₁=t in A gives the constant polynomial α in ℂ[t], then A=C(α)X₀^n in MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (A : ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n)) (α : ℂ), MvPolynomial.eval₂ Polynomial.C (fun j : Fin 2 => if j = 0 then 1 else Polynomial.X) A.val = Polynomial.C α → A.val = MvPolynomial.C α * MvPolynomial.X (0 : Fin 2) ^ n
